comparators: separate PEBA restoring skeleton plus local friction faces

measure: 50 C dry, immersion, drained and contaminated static friction after dwell 1 min, 9 min and operating idle durations
kinetic friction separately at actual proposed contact speeds
matching-state flexural relaxation and fatigue, not tensile strength or catalog room-temperature E
prestrain retention under 4-5 h hold and weather ageing
Several normal loads to distinguish apparent static friction from an additive adhesion term; avoid counting wet adhesion twice
stages.gate: actual combined properties satisfy mechanism bounds with measurement uncertainty and margin; no unmeasured product substitution

measure: adhesion force curve and liquid bridge rupture distance
total force-displacement loop and rebound energy
stages.gate: entire path reaches recovered position after unload; bridge breaks before tangential reset; repeat at degraded state

measure: 450 mm entire bed after 300 mm gouging
30 degree downslope retention and wet bed density
same ski, edge, speed and loads vs groomed fresh snow; penetration, peak, release length, glide, vibration, stop/restart
winter snow interface shear, drainage and additional melting vs natural ground
stages.gate: predeclared snow-reference acceptance ranges; no exposed mat substitute

measure: washed first pass without transfer film
grooming plus collection and grading throughput within 60 minute closure
ultraviolet and repeated wear; mass loss and airborne/waterborne fragments
stages.gate: functional recovery plus safety and cost, not redistribution alone

stop_or_branch.condition: H58 static friction exceeds derived limit at measured E
stop_or_branch.action: change path or material pair, do not count kinetic friction as substitute

stop_or_branch.condition: H59 needs >15 um separation or local residual pressure exceeds computed limit
stop_or_branch.action: redesign opening stroke/loading route or compare non-sliding damping; do not increase preload without force, strain and cost audit

stop_or_branch.condition: dispersion blend needs continually renewed transfer film
stop_or_branch.action: test mechanically retained surface part and capture of wear; reject uncontrolled outdoor release

stop_or_branch.condition: material meets mean but loses margin under swelling/ageing
stop_or_branch.action: include conditioned tolerances and failure range before sample scaling

probability_definition: Independent lots and prespecified realistic operating scenarios; all required functional/safety gates jointly satisfied. No estimate from parameter grids or literature rows.
authorization: No purchase, laboratory operation, supplier contact or communication outside GitHub performed.
